name: Precision Bass Standard
description: The legendary tone that started it all. Rich, powerful low-end with punchy midrange growl.
detailedDescription: The Fender Precision Bass has defined the sound of rock, pop, and country for over 70 years. Featuring a split-coil pickup that delivers thick, punchy tone with excellent note definition. The comfortable C-shaped maple neck and smooth satin finish make for effortless playability.

name: Jazz Bass Professional II
description: Versatile bass with bright, articulate tone and exceptional playability.
detailedDescription: The Professional II Jazz Bass delivers the classic J-Bass sound with modern refinements. Dual single-coil pickups provide incredible tonal versatility, from deep, warm neck pickup tones to bright, cutting bridge pickup sounds. The slim C-shaped neck profile offers fast, comfortable playing.

name: StingRay Special 4H
description: Iconic active bass with powerful humbucker and 3-band EQ for modern tones.
detailedDescription: The Music Man StingRay Special combines classic StingRay DNA with modern appointments. The ceramic humbucker pickup delivers punchy, aggressive tone that cuts through any mix. The 3-band active EQ provides extensive tonal shaping capabilities, while the roasted maple neck offers superior stability and resonance.

name: Thunderbird Studio
description: Distinctive reverse body design with powerful humbuckers and rock attitude.
detailedDescription: The Gibson Thunderbird Studio delivers the iconic T-Bird tone that has powered rock music for decades. Dual TB Plus humbuckers provide massive low-end power with excellent note clarity. The mahogany through-neck construction ensures sustain and stability, while the reverse body design offers perfect balance.

name: SR505E 5-String
description: Extended range 5-string with modern electronics and comfortable neck profile.
detailedDescription: The Ibanez SR505E offers professional features at an affordable price. The Bartolini MK1 pickups and 3-band EQ deliver versatile tones suitable for any style. The Jatoba fretboard provides clear, bright attack, while the SR5 5-piece maple/walnut neck offers incredible stability and sustain.

name: Hofner 500/1 Violin Bass
description: Iconic hollow-body bass made famous by Paul McCartney with warm, woody tone.
detailedDescription: The Hofner 500/1 Violin Bass is one of the most recognizable instruments in music history. Its hollow body construction delivers a warm, woody tone that sits perfectly in any mix. The short 30-inch scale makes it extremely comfortable to play, while the classic sunburst finish adds vintage appeal.

name: American Professional II Jazz Bass
description: Premium American-made Jazz Bass with V-Mod II pickups and modern features.
detailedDescription: The American Professional II Jazz Bass represents the pinnacle of Fender craftsmanship. V-Mod II Jazz Bass pickups deliver vintage-inspired tone with modern clarity and output. The Deep C neck profile with rolled fingerboard edges provides supreme comfort, while the Posiflex graphite support rods ensure stability.

name: Rickenbacker 4003
description: Legendary bass with distinctive jangly tone and beautiful craftsmanship.
detailedDescription: The Rickenbacker 4003 has been the choice of progressive rock legends for decades. Its distinctive tone combines punchy low-end with bright, articulate highs that cut through dense mixes. The trademark Rick-O-Sound stereo output allows for incredible tonal possibilities when used with dual amplifiers.
